notes: t007-t008 to go is the verse's one added unit: a whole supplied lexical verb for a clause whose Hebrew has none (rules 20, 30), the ASV italics corroborating but not deciding it (rule 7).
The marginal alternative rendering restructures the whole first half of the verse and is not the text aligned.
לֹא takes only not and the verb keeps may be remembered: the ASV writes negation and modal as separate words, so nothing is indivisible (rule 35).
The object suffix's them need not agree in number with the 3fs הָ; the ASV's pronoun answers to the referent it has in view (rule 18).
